entities.summary: Sophie Bosede Oluwole was a Nigerian professor and philosopher, and the first person to earn a doctorate in philosophy at a Nigerian university. She was a practitioner of Yoruba philosophy, a way of thinking that stems from the ethnic group based in Nigeria. She was vocal about the role of women in philosophy and the underrepresentation of African thinkers in education.
